subject: Request: rebalance exec demo slot + VP coverage options — StellarEx

Cc: Priya Malhotra <pmalhotra@stellarex.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Planning the exec demo — initial availability

Hi Ava — thanks for the quick outreach. VP (Rupal) can join the week of Nov 15 but will be traveling midday on the 17th. CTO (Priya) prefers the 17th morning. Is there any flexibility to move the meeting a touch earlier or split attendance? Would also like to see a one-page agenda ahead of time.

Sanjay

From: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Priya Malhotra <pmalhotra@stellarex.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 18:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Planning the exec demo — initial availability

Thanks Sanjay — totally understand the travel constraint. Quick proposal so we can finalize and get calendar invites out: 

Option A — Single slot, shifted earlier (preferred)
- Move the demo on Tue Nov 17 to 9:00–9:45 PT so both VP and CTO can attend before travel.
- Redwood execs: Ava (product), Ben (eng ops) present; 30-min demo + 15-min Q&A.

Option B — Split presence + recording
- Keep Nov 17 at the current hold (11:00 PT). CTO Priya attends live for the technical walkthrough; VP Rupal joins a 30-min follow-up sync (Nov 18 or a 30-min private briefing). We'll record the session and provide timestamps.

I attached a one-page agenda and a draft mutual action plan so procurement has visibility. If neither works we can propose Nov 16 morning as an alternative. Which do you prefer?

Cheers,
Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments: StellarEx-demo-agenda.pdf (PDF), mutual_action_plan_stellarex.xlsx (XLSX)

To: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@stellarex.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 09:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Planning the exec demo — initial availability

Ava — thanks for laying out options. I can do Option B (I’ll take the 11:00 PT slot) and I’ll stay for the technical deep dive. If you can record, that will help Rupal catch up later. Two small asks:
- Can the recording include a 5-min executive summary at the top so Rupal can watch a short clip?
- Please include a quick slide on data handling/Private deployment and SLA wording (we have procurement questions).

Priya
